title: Halloween Bunny Yoga Houston Benefitting a Local Rabbit Rescue
description: A gentle, all-levels Halloween bunny yoga class with adoptable rabbits from a local Houston rabbit rescue. Ages 18+.
long_description:
A gentle, all-levels Halloween bunny yoga class with adoptable rabbits from a local Houston rabbit rescue. Ages 18+.

About this Event

Breathe, stretch, and make a fluffy new friend — Halloween bunny yoga comes to Houston on Saturday, October 31.
Join Kitten Paws and Downward Dogs at The Space Between Yoga Studio for a gentle, all-levels 60-minute yoga class with adoptable rabbits from a local Houston rabbit rescue hopping freely around the room for the entire class. Costumes welcome — just nothing a bunny could get tangled in.
Every ticket supports our rescue partner, and we'll name them here as soon as they're confirmed. Rescue volunteers will be on site to answer adoption questions — you might just leave with more than a good stretch!
Good to know: This is an 18+ event held in a fully indoor, climate-controlled studio. Mats are provided — just wear comfortable clothing. All levels are welcome, including total beginners. Tickets are non-refundable but fully transferable — send a friend in your place.
Kitten Paws and Downward Dogs is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that works with rescues only — never breeders. Every event benefits a local animal rescue.
